mentions.name: Personal Finance Is Boring (PFIB)
mentions.description: A website (PFIB) that helps people who accidentally made personal finance an obsessive hobby step back from it and return to other hobbies and better uses of their time.
mentions.problem: People who let personal finance become an obsessive hobby that crowds out other hobbies and better uses of their time.
mentions.audience: People who turned personal finance into an obsessive hobby and want to return to other hobbies and better uses of their time.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building https://personalfinanceisboring.com (PFIB) to help people like me who accidentally made personal finance an obsessive hobby, and would like to return to other hobbies and better uses of their time.

evidence.value: I'm building https://personalfinanceisboring.com (PFIB) to help people like me who accidentally made personal finance an obsessive hobby, and would like to return to other hobbies and better uses of their time.
